title: Case Overview
summary: This section presents the case of Mohazab v Dick Smith Electronics Pty Ltd, addressing the appeal related to the unlawful termination of employment and the employer's initiative.
content:
200 INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS COURT OF AUST [(1995)
[INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS COURT OF AUSTRALIA]
MOHAZAB v DICK SMITH ELECTRONICS PTY LTD (No 2) *
Lee, Moore and Marshall JJ
28 November 1995
Termination of Employment — Unlawful termination — Appeal — Principles — Whether termination at initiative of employer — Letter of resignation signed by employee after being accused of dishonesty — Mistaken view of his situation — Held, termination was ‘‘at the initiative of the employer’’ — Appeal upheld — Industrial Relations Act 1988 (Cth), Pt VIA, Div 3, ss 420, 423.
